prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: the snowy tops of rock walls seen from above: rock mostly covered by thick snow with icy edges The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square, seamless repeating TILEABLE terrain texture for a premium modern hi-bit pixel-art top-down JRPG map: the snowy TOP SURFACES of rocky walls viewed almost straight from above, thick settled snow covering most of the uneven stone, occasional exposed earthy blue-gray / muted mauve rock patches, icy cyan-blue edging and small frosty crevices. Entire square edge-to-edge texture surface, no side view of walls, no horizon, no scene, no isolated centerpiece, no objects, no characters, no text or border. DISTRIBUTE varied irregular snow-rock clusters evenly across whole tile. Critically seamless both axes: features/colors at left and right edges match and continue; features/colors at upper and lower edges match and continue, suitable for infinite repeat. Crisp deliberately hand-placed square art pixels, identical pixel size throughout image (roughly 8x8 display pixels per art pixel), pixel cluster shapes 3–10 art pixels, clean hard boundaries, no anti-aliasing, blur, gradients, noise, dither checkerboards or photographic details. Color ramps 4–6 shades per material: snow off-white and warm pale yellow highlights, icy muted blue midtones, richer purplish-red shadows, earth-toned muted rocky cracks. Orthographic classic steep top-down RPG view with no perspective convergence. Neutral even soft upper-left lighting, clean base colors as if overcast evening; absolutely no cast shadows, darkness, glowing or vignette. About 256 x 256 art pixels, upscale with nearest-neighbor pixel-perfect edges. Visually polished game-ready terrain tile.
